import re

def parse_iso_duration(s: str) -> int:
    if not isinstance(s, str) or not s.startswith('P') or s == 'P':
        raise ValueError("Invalid duration")

    body = s[1:]
    date_part, sep, time_part = body.partition('T')

    if sep and time_part == '':
        raise ValueError("Invalid duration: empty time section after T")

    date_pattern = r'(?:(\d+)Y)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)D)?'
    m = re.fullmatch(date_pattern, date_part)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError("Invalid date component")
    years, months, days = m.groups()

    hours = minutes = seconds = None
    if sep:
        time_pattern = r'(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?'
        tm = re.fullmatch(time_pattern, time_part)
        if not tm:
            raise ValueError("Invalid time component")
        hours, minutes, seconds = tm.groups()

    if not any([years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds]):
        raise ValueError("No components present")

    total = 0
    if years: total += int(years) * 365 * 86400
    if months: total += int(months) * 30 * 86400
    if days: total += int(days) * 86400
    if hours: total += int(hours) * 3600
    if minutes: total += int(minutes) * 60
    if seconds: total += int(seconds)

    return total
